rows.invariant: Malformed producer output never becomes gate PASS; envelope, timestamp, evidenceRefs and observations are validated before consumption.
Only compatible lineage may be consumed; incompatible evidence blocks and exact dependency run is recorded.
NOT_RUN exists only at aggregator; unavailable prerequisite/error is BLOCKED; observed violation FAIL; evidenced assertions PASS.
Evidence producers return evidence only and cannot emit RUNTIME_AUTHORIZED or perform publication activation.
Transition provenance is bound to eventId,current candidate,publicationId,authority evidence and RFC3339 transitionAt; PASS exposes the normalized authorityRef for downstream continuity checks.
Only LAB>QUALIFIED, QUALIFIED>PUBLISHED and PUBLISHED>WITHDRAWN are lawful and requested edge equals actual edge.
QUALIFIED>PUBLISHED requires same-candidate and same-authority Q9 authorization; publication is never inferred from deployment.

Admission receipt binding,publication identity and authority provenance equal the current candidate and the exact authorityRef attested by consumed Q5 provenance; a self-consistent foreign authority fails.
Only QUALIFIED complete identity is admitted toward Q9; LAB,unknown,fixture,prototype and premature PUBLISHED are rejected.
Q1 consumes the exact Q6 run and relevant build/index changes invalidate Q6/Q1 evidence.

Q1 owns execution of the sealed-preauthorization probe through its adapter and consumes only the receipt produced internally for the current candidate, publication, exact Q6 run and surfaceArtifactDigest; caller-supplied declarative objects or prebuilt receipts cannot substitute the probe.

Q1 qualifies only observations produced during its own SEALED_PREAUTH probe execution; missing/invalid adapter, receipt injection, stale observation time, lab reachability, public exposure, undeclared entrypoint or permissive denial behavior fail closed.
Governed change domains invalidate affected evidence and an unclassified change blocks review.
Audit evidence is structurally qualified; HIGH/CRITICAL fail closed and malformed evidence blocks.
